units.source_text: 中纳言薰君闻得八亲王死耗，扼腕悼惜不置。

en.t: When Middle Counselor Kaoru heard the news of the Eighth Prince's death, he wrung his hands and grieved without cease.

units.source_text: 他希望再度和他会面，从容地谈谈心中未罄之言。

en.t: He had hoped to meet him once more and speak calmly of all that still remained in his heart.

units.source_text: 如今历历回思人世普遍无常之态，不禁痛哭失声。

en.t: Now, as he vividly recalled how impermanence touches all human life, he could not help breaking down in tears.

units.source_text: 他想：“我和他最后一次见面之时，他曾对我说：‘与君相见，今日恐是最后一次了。’

en.t: He thought, "When I last met him, he said to me, 'Today may be the last time I see you.'"

units.source_text: 只因他生性比别人敏感，惯说人生无常，朝不保夕之言，故我听了这句话并不放在心上。

en.t: Because he was by nature more sensitive than others and often spoke of life's uncertainty and the fragility of each day, I did not take those words to heart.

units.source_text: 岂知不多几日真成永诀！”

en.t: How could I have known that within only a few days it would truly become an eternal farewell?"

units.source_text: 他反复思量，追悔莫及，不胜悲伤。

en.t: He turned it over in his mind again and again, filled with regret too late to mend, and was overwhelmed by sorrow.

units.source_text: 便遣使赴阿阇梨山寺及女公子山庄隆重吊唁。

en.t: He then sent messengers to the Ajari's mountain temple and to the young ladies' mountain villa to offer solemn condolences.

units.source_text: 山庄中除了薰君以外，竟别无吊客上门，光景好不凄凉。

en.t: At the villa, apart from Kaoru, no other mourners came at all, and the scene was deeply desolate.

units.source_text: 两位女公子虽已心烦意乱，也深感薰君多年以来的美意。

en.t: Though the two young ladies were already distraught, they deeply appreciated Kaoru's kindness over so many years.

units.source_text: 死别虽是世间常有之事，但在身当其事者看来，悲痛无可比拟。

en.t: Though parting by death is common in the world, to those who suffer it themselves the grief is beyond compare.

units.source_text: 何况两位女公子身世孤单，无人相慰，更不知何等伤心。

en.t: All the more so for the two young ladies, alone in the world with no one to comfort them; who could know how heartbroken they were?

units.source_text: 薰君深感同情，推想亲王故后应做种种功德，便备办许多供养物品，送交阿阇梨山寺。

en.t: Kaoru felt deep sympathy and, thinking that many meritorious rites should be performed after the prince's death, prepared numerous offerings and sent them to the Ajari's mountain temple.

units.source_text: 山庄方面，也送去许多布施物品，托付那老侍女办理，关怀十分周至。

en.t: He also sent many alms to the villa, entrusting their handling to the old attendant, and his care was thoroughly attentive.
